ic_name: LIN bus 2.2A (Local Interconnect Network, LIN Consortium)
opcode_synthesis_skipped_reason: L2.protocol_overview.half_duplex is not True and no explicit opcode/command-table heading was found in input/docs/. Free-form hex bytes in prose, SVG labels, or PDF text do not constitute opcode evidence.
protocol_type: Single-master schedule-table-driven serial bus on a single wire (LIN bus line). Each frame = header from master + response from one publishing slave. Byte-oriented (UART framing on each non-break byte).

control_strobes: RD / RD (read; either active edge works)
WR / WR (write; either active edge works)
host_bus_interface.address_strobe: ADS (latches A0-A2 + CS0-CS2 on positive edge if used; tie LOW if not needed)
host_bus_interface.buffer_disable_output: DDIS (LOW during CPU reads from UART)

rows: RBR (R) / THR (W) — Receiver Buffer / Transmitter Holding
IIR (R) / FCR (W) — Interrupt Identification / FIFO Control

channels_serial_side.name: SIN
channels_serial_side.description: Serial data input from peripheral/modem. Idle HIGH.

channels_serial_side.name: SOUT
channels_serial_side.description: Serial data output to peripheral/modem. Idle HIGH.

channels_serial_side.name: CTS
channels_serial_side.description: Clear to Send (active LOW); modem status only — does not gate transmitter.

channels_serial_side.name: RTS
channels_serial_side.description: Request to Send (active LOW); MCR bit 1.

channels_serial_side.name: DSR
channels_serial_side.description: Data Set Ready (active LOW); modem status.

channels_serial_side.name: DTR
channels_serial_side.description: Data Terminal Ready (active LOW); MCR bit 0.

channels_serial_side.name: DCD
channels_serial_side.description: Data Carrier Detect (active LOW); modem status.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no per-byte ACK or VALID/READY handshake on the serial wire — UART is asynchronous with frame-level start/stop framing.
Host-bus side uses RD/WR strobes with stable A0-A2 + CS0-CS2.
Hardware flow control (when used): RTS asserted = UART ready to receive; CTS asserted = modem ready to receive. CTS does NOT gate transmitter directly — software interprets MSR.CTS.

frame_format.parity_bit: Optional; even / odd / stick (mark or space).
frame_format.stop_bits: 1, 1.5 (5-bit char only), or 2 bits, always HIGH.

channels.name: CAN bus
channels.description: Single shared channel (single-wire-plus-ground OR differential pair OR optical) carrying NRZ-coded bits; dominant overrides recessive.

frame_types.name: DATA FRAME
frame_types.purpose: Carries data from a transmitter to receivers; bit fields S-O-F + ARBITRATION + CONTROL + DATA + CRC + ACK + EOF.

frame_types.name: REMOTE FRAME
frame_types.purpose: Requests transmission of the DATA FRAME with same IDENTIFIER; RTR=recessive; no DATA FIELD.

frame_types.name: ERROR FRAME
frame_types.purpose: Signals an error condition; ERROR FLAG + ERROR DELIMITER.

frame_types.name: OVERLOAD FRAME
frame_types.purpose: Delays the next DATA/REMOTE FRAME; OVERLOAD FLAG + OVERLOAD DELIMITER.

data_frame_fields.components: CRC SEQUENCE (15 bits) + CRC DELIMITER (1 recessive)
ACK SLOT (1 transmitter-recessive / receivers-dominant) + ACK DELIMITER (1 recessive)

data_length_code_encoding.note: Admissible numbers of data bytes: {0, 1, ..., 7, 8}. Other values may not be used.

remote_frame_rules: RTR bit = recessive (vs dominant for DATA FRAME).
Same IDENTIFIER as the requested DATA FRAME.
If a DATA FRAME and REMOTE FRAME with same IDENTIFIER start simultaneously, the DATA FRAME prevails.

interframe_space.bus_idle: arbitrary length; any unit may start a transmission
interframe_space.suspend_transmission: 8 recessive bits added by an error-passive transmitter after its message

break_field.note: Break is the only field that does not comply with the UART byte-field structure. A break/sync sequence shall always be detectable by slave tasks; an in-progress frame shall be aborted and processing of the new frame shall commence on a break/sync detection.

frame_structure.sync_byte_purpose: Slaves without a precise time base measure the alternating edges of 0x55 to compute the master's nominal bit time and resynchronise their UART.

protected_identifier.id_bits: ID0..ID5 = bits 0..5 of PID byte (LSB first).

id_categories.name: Signal-carrying frames
id_categories.checksum: classic for LIN 1.x slaves, enhanced for LIN 2.x slaves

id_categories.name: Reserved (LIN extended format)
id_categories.checksum: shall not be used in a LIN 2.x cluster

checksum_models.name: classic
checksum_models.applies_to: Diagnostic frames (0x3C, 0x3D) and frames going to LIN 1.x slaves.

checksum_algorithm: Eight-bit sum with carry, then bit-inverted: sum all bytes; whenever sum ≥ 256 subtract 255 (equivalent to add-with-carry); finally invert the 8-bit result. Receiver adds the received checksum to its intermediate sum; result shall be 0xFF.

schedule_table.frame_slot_definition: T_Frame_Slot = T_base × n (n integer, normally different per slot). Slot must satisfy T_Frame_Slot > jitter + T_Frame_Maximum.
schedule_table.switch_behaviour: Active schedule processed cyclically. Switch request to new schedule is honoured only at the start of the next frame slot — never mid-frame.

host_interface_assumption: On a node, the LIN protocol is implemented on top of a UART/SCI peripheral or equivalent state machine. There is no LIN-defined CPU host-bus register interface — that is vendor-specific (e.g. LIN transceiver IC + microcontroller UART).
